notes.title: Updates due to Talk Like A Pirate Day!☠️⚓️
notes.notes:
Ahoy mates, I congra'late y'all happy national Talk Like A Pirate Day! The day when we shall take up all them enemy skulls, to dig up all them treasures and to share them happines with the crew. If yer feel alone- than just feel the pirate spirit and inspire! 

I want to share ya some progress I've made in the game throgh this time:
I'd burned out due to low interest level to the game, so I caculated that it'll take a long to finish the game- so I've came up to cut off some features. I've started to working on pirates and skeletons itselves.

notes.title: Screenshot Saturday #3
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow player!

It is Screenshot Saturday again- a day when indie developers shares its game's progress. 

This week I was mainly concentrated on gamedesign. Even so, I added a lot of cool stuff in the game. Let's go! 🦜

[h1]Fishes [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655344/d3fa4f7116c0f68f62ac65b2b7e05eb15a42be06.gif[/img]

notes.title: Screenshot Saturday #2
notes.notes:
Ahoy, mateys!

It is Saturday. And you know what it means: It is #ScreenshotSaturday day and all the inides are showin'off their progress. And of course I'm participating. I've been doing this on Twitter so far, but I thought that I can make use of the Steam from now on.

Unfortunately, I missed Screenshot Saturday past week. So I'll show you now results of last 2 weeks!

Currently I am working on creating a new skeletons, with whom you have to fight 🦴💀. Already two of them are almost painted (but I have to work on animation), that's...
